description:
List the Google Analytics 4 properties connected to the authenticated user's projects. Each entry returns the project `id` and `url` (use either as the `property` argument for the other GA4 tools), the human title, the underlying GA4 `ga4_property_id`, and `connected_at`. Only projects with a connected GA4 property are returned.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// List all GA4 properties connected to the authenticated user.
[]
```
name: list_ga4_properties
title: Analytics properties
